If there is a problem with the Audit table, then other tests are suspect... */ /*  */ SELECT 'Audit table batches' AS Test, NULL AS Batch, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BatchID) FROM Audit) = 3 AND (SELECT MAX(BatchID) FROM Audit) = 3 THEN 'OK' ELSE 'Not 3 batches' END AS Result, 'There must be audit data for 3 batches' AS Description UNION SELECT 'Audit table sources' AS Test, NULL AS Batch, AS Result, 'There must be audit data for all data sets' AS Description /*  */ /* Checks against the DImessages table. */ /*  */ UNION SELECT 'DImessages validation reports', BatchID, Result, 'Every (SELECT MAX(BatchID) FROM DImessages) = 3 THEN 'OK' ELSE 'Not 3 batches plus batch 0' END, 'Must have 3 distinct batches reported in DImessages' UNION SELECT 'DImessages Phase complete records', NULL, initial condition', NULL, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DImessages WHERE BatchID = 0 AND MessageType = 'Validation' AND MessageData <> '0') = 0 THEN 'OK' ELSE 'Non-empty table in before Batch1' END, FROM Audit WHERE DataSet = 'DimBroker' AND Attribute = 'HR_BROKERS') THEN 'OK' ELSE 'Mismatch' END, 'Actual row count matches Audit table' UNION SELECT 'DimBroker distinct keys', NULL, CASE WHEN SELECT 'DimBroker BatchID', 1, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DimBroker WHERE BatchID <> 1) = 0 THEN 'OK' ELSE 'Not batch 1' END, 'All rows report BatchID = 1' UNION SELECT 'DimBroker IsCurrent', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DimBroker WHERE EffectiveDate <> '1950-01-01') = 0 THEN 'OK' ELSE 'Wrong date' END, 'All rows have Batch1 BatchDate as EffectiveDate' UNION SELECT 'DimBroker EndDate', NULL, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DimBroker WHERE EndDate <> '9999-12-31') = 0 THEN 'OK' ELSE 'Wrong date' END, 'All rows have end of time as EndDate' /*  */ /* Checks against the DimAccount table. */ /*  */ UNION SELECT 'DimAccount row count', 1, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DimAccount WHERE BatchID = 1) > (SELECT Value FROM Audit WHERE DataSet = 'DimCustomer' AND Attribute = 'C_NEW' AND BatchID = 1) = 1) + (SELECT Value FROM Audit WHERE DataSet = 'DimAccount' AND Attribute = 'CA_UPDACCT' AND BatchID = 1) + (SELECT Value FROM Audit WHERE DataSet = 'DimCustomer' AND Attribute = 'C_UPDCUST' AND BatchID = 1) + (SELECT Value FROM Audit WHERE DataSet = 'DimCustomer' AND Attribute = 'C_INACT' AND BatchID = 1) - (SELECT Value FROM Audit WHERE DataSet = 'DimCustomer' AND Attribute = 'C_ID_HIST' DimAccount WHERE BatchID = a.BatchID) >= (SELECT Value FROM Audit WHERE DataSet = 'DimAccount' AND Attribute = 'CA_ADDACCT' AND BatchID = a.BatchID) + (SELECT Value FROM Audit WHERE DataSet = tests together check for validity of the EffectiveDate and EndDate handling: */ /*   'DimAccount EndDate' checks that effective and end dates line up */ /*   'DimAccount Overlap' checks that there are 'FactCashBalances' AS MessageSource, 'Row count joined' AS MessageText, COUNT(*) AS MessageData FROM FactCashBalances AS f INNER JOIN DimAccount AS a ON f.SK_AccountID = a.SK_AccountID INNER JOIN DimCustomer AS c ON f.SK_CustomerID = c.SK_CustomerID INNER JOIN DimBroker AS b ON a.SK_BrokerID = b.SK_BrokerID INNER JOIN DimDate AS d ON f.SK_DateID = d.SK_DateID UNION SELECT 'FactHoldings' AS MessageSource, 'Row count joined' AS MessageText, COUNT(*) AS MessageData FROM FactHoldings AS f INNER JOIN DimAccount AS a ON f.SK_AccountID = a.SK_AccountID INNER JOIN DimCustomer AS c ON f.SK_CustomerID = c.SK_CustomerID INNER JOIN DimBroker AS b ON a.SK_BrokerID = b.SK_BrokerID INNER JOIN DimDate AS d ON f.SK_DateID = d.SK_DateID INNER JOIN DimTime AS t ON f.SK_TimeID = t.SK_TimeID INNER JOIN DimCompany AS m ON f.SK_CompanyID = m.SK_CompanyID INNER JOIN DimSecurity AS s ON f.SK_SecurityID = s.SK_SecurityID UNION SELECT 'FactMarketHistory' AS MessageSource, 'Row count joined' AS
